components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact square action used for the next committed step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:"Barlow Condensed",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; color:var(--color-bg,#f2f2f3); background:var(--color-accent-700,#416180); border:1px solid var(--color-accent-700,#416180); border-radius:0; padding:var(--space-2,6.8px) 12.24px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-800,#2c455d); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--color-accent-900,#1d2d3d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A full-border action for alternatives and cancellation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:"Barlow Condensed",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--color-divider,#1d1f2029); border-radius:0; padding:var(--space-2,6.8px) 12.24px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#1d1f20) 7%,transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#1d1f20) 14%,transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet inline action for removal, closing, or low-priority changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:"Barlow Condensed",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; color:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); background:transparent; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0; padding:var(--space-2,6.8px) var(--space-1,3.4px); cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#5980a6) 10%,transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-accent,#5980a6) 18%,transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The square, filled field used for search and profile editing.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:5px; color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:36px; padding:6px 10px; font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); caret-color:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); background:var(--color-surface,#e9e9ea); border:1px solid var(--color-divider,#1d1f2029); border-radius:0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#1d1f20) 45%,transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Accent Tag
components.description: A compact skill, ratio, or selected-state label.
components.css: .ds-tag-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.02em; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:0; color:var(--color-accent-800,#2c455d); background:var(--color-accent-100,#eef6ff); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: The two-state mode switch shared by browse and workspace views.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--color-divider,#1d1f2029); border-radius:0; color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:7px 12px; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg-opt + .ds-seg-opt { border-left:1px solid var(--color-divider,#1d1f2029); } .ds-seg-opt input { position:absolute; opacity:0; width:0; height:0; } .ds-seg-opt:has(input:checked) { color:var(--color-bg,#f2f2f3); background:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); } .ds-seg-opt:not(:has(input:checked)):hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#1d1f20) 7%,transparent); } .ds-seg-opt:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Blueprint Card
components.description: The signature flat container for gigs, evidence, and workspace panels.
components.html:
React

Build a landing-page component

Fits your Tuesday 7pm–10pm window.
components.css: .ds-blueprint { position:relative; display:grid; gap:var(--space-2,6.8px); padding:var(--space-3,10.2px); color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--color-divider,#1d1f2029); border-radius:0; font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-blueprint h3 { margin:0; font-family:"Barlow Condensed",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:17px; line-height:1.2; } .ds-blueprint p { margin:0; font-size:13px; } .ds-blueprint small { color:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); } .ds-corner { position:absolute; width:11px; height:11px; color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-text,#1d1f20) 55%,transparent); } .ds-corner::before,.ds-corner::after { content:""; position:absolute; background:currentColor; } .ds-corner::before { left:5px; top:0; width:1px; height:100%; } .ds-corner::after { top:5px; left:0; width:100%; height:1px; } .ds-tl { top:-6px; left:-6px; } .ds-tr { top:-6px; right:-6px; } .ds-bl { bottom:-6px; left:-6px; } .ds-br { bottom:-6px; right:-6px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: The flat sticky rail that preserves mode, search, and cart context.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--space-4,13.6px); padding:var(--space-3,10.2px) var(--space-4,13.6px); color:var(--color-text,#1d1f20); background:var(--color-bg,#f2f2f3); font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-brand { margin-right:auto; font-family:"Barlow Condensed",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; } .ds-brand span { color:var(--color-accent-700,#416180); } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color:var(--color-accent,#5980a6); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-accent,#5980a6); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
CampusGigs should feel like a working drawing spread across a drafting table: precise enough to trust, unfinished only where the user is meant to act, and visibly organized around real constraints. Barlow Condensed gives headings and actions an engineered economy; Barlow keeps dense task content readable. Registration marks, square controls, thin rules, and restrained blue-gray signals make the interface feel measured rather than ornamental.

The workspace is a product surface, not a campaign. Information density is welcome when it helps a student compare demand, capacity, price, and compatible work windows. Familiar controls must remain familiar. The system explicitly rejects a generic Fiverr or Upwork clone, a childish student portal, futuristic AI-dashboard theatrics, and any decorative “smart” effect that competes with the scheduling and market evidence.

New and revised workspace surfaces must reflow into one complete column at 380px without horizontal page scrolling. No ambient animation belongs in the foundation; future motion must communicate state, respect reduced-motion preferences, and never delay the task.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, structural surfaces separated by hairline rules.
Square, compact controls with unmistakable states.
Restrained drafting blue reserved for actions, selection, and evidence.
Condensed headings paired with a legible workhorse body face.
Responsive density that reveals structure without hiding information.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Decoration never outranks availability, demand, pay, duration, or compatibility.

rules.name: The One Drafting Blue Rule
rules.body: Drafting Blue owns action, selection, and evidence; Plate Blue may support it but never creates a second primary-action language.

rules.name: The Contrast Is Structural Rule
rules.body: Body copy, placeholders, metadata, and button labels must meet WCAG 2.2 AA. Workbench Ground text on base Drafting Blue is only 3.71:1 and is prohibited for small controls; filled primary actions start at Drafting Blue—Active.

rules.name: The Condensed-for-Control Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed belongs to headings, amounts, and actions; form values, descriptions, and dense metadata remain in Barlow.

rules.name: The No-Poster Rule
rules.body: Workspace headings remain fixed-size and task-scaled. Fluid hero typography and oversized marketing type are prohibited inside the product.

rules.name: The Flat Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Cards and page sections stay shadowless. If a resting surface needs a shadow to be understood, its border, spacing, or hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The One Control Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, tabs, and dialogs share the same square geometry, focus language, and restrained state colors across both client and freelancer modes.

dos: Do use Drafting Blue—Active (#416180) for filled primary actions and Drafting Blue (#5980a6) for selected controls, borders, and evidence—not ambient decoration.
Do keep cards flat with a one-pixel Construction Line (#1d1f2029) and 10.2px default padding.
Do use Barlow Condensed for headings and actions, while keeping descriptions, fields, and metadata in Barlow.
Do reflow the workspace into one complete column at 380px with no horizontal page scroll.
Do provide keyboard, text, and icon equivalents for interactions that currently depend on dragging, pointer precision, or color.
donts: Don't turn CampusGigs into a generic Fiverr or Upwork clone.
Don't add futuristic AI-dashboard theatrics, marketplace theatre, or decorative “smart” effects.
Don't use full-card shadows, soft ghost cards, glassmorphism, gradient text, or oversized rounded containers.
Don't promote the striped image placeholder into a brand motif; replace it with meaningful assets or a quiet empty state.
Don't add onboarding or marketing-page patterns to the workspace foundation; that later surface uses its own brand/marketing register.
